response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID), d AS (SELECT ID, SEX, igm, igm - AVG(igm) OVER () AS dev FROM j), s AS (SELECT ID, SEX, igm, dev, AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS sex_avg_dev FROM d) SELECT ID, SEX, igm AS `aCL IgM`, dev AS deviation_from_overall_mean, dev - sex_avg_dev AS excess_over_sex_avg_deviation FROM s WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND dev > sex_avg_dev ORDER BY dev - sex_avg_dev DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is taken over joined examinations that have a non-null aCL IgM, so examinations without a matching patient are excluded from it.
Rows with NULL SEX are excluded from the output, because a missing sex matches no group. A blank sex is kept as its own group.
Ties in the excess are broken arbitrarily.
